description: Source code for a rule evaluation engine used in the hookify plugin, including rule matching logic, regex caching, and rule evaluation methods.

classes.name: RuleEngine
classes.description: Class responsible for evaluating rules against hook input data, including matching rules, conditions, and generating decision responses.

methods.name: evaluate_rules
methods.description: Evaluates a list of rules against input data, prioritizing blocking rules, and returns a decision or message.

methods.name: _rule_matches
methods.description: Checks if a specific rule matches the provided input data based on conditions and tool matching.

methods.name: _matches_tool
methods.description: Determines if the tool name matches the rule's tool matcher pattern.

methods.name: _check_condition
methods.description: Checks if a single condition matches the input data and tool input.

methods.name: _extract_field
methods.description: Extracts relevant field value from tool input or hook input data for condition evaluation.

methods.name: _regex_match
methods.description: Performs regex matching using cached compiled regex patterns.
